great.name: Room Rent
great.quote: The eligible Room Rent or Room Category applicable for the Insured Person under the Policy is 'No limit', which means that there is no separate restriction on Room Charges incurred towards stay during Hospitalization
great.explanation: You can choose any room during hospitalization without any limit on room rent charges. This means no capping or deductions on your room rent expenses.

great.name: ICU Charges
great.quote: The eligible ICU Charges applicable for the Insured Person under the Policy is 'No limit', which means that there is no separate restriction on ICU Charges incurred towards stay in ICU during Hospitalization.
great.explanation: ICU charges are fully covered without any cap, reducing your out-of-pocket expenses during critical care.

great.name: Restore Benefit
great.quote: automatically make the re-instatement of up to the base Sum Insured unlimited times in a policy year... (iii) Recharge amount can be utilized for same illness as well as different Illnesses.
great.explanation: The policy restores your base sum insured unlimited times within the same year, including for the same illness, giving you extra financial protection.

great.name: Built-in SI Buffer
great.quote: An additional amount as specified in the Policy Schedule will be available... (d) The Plus Benefit will be applicable only after exhaustion of Base Sum Insured.
great.explanation: Extra sum insured is available after you exhaust the base sum insured, providing additional coverage as per your policy schedule.

great.name: No Claim Bonus
great.quote: enhance the Sum Insured by 50% flat, on a cumulative basis... (vi) In the event of a Claim there is no impact on the accrual of Cumulative Bonus.
great.explanation: Your sum insured increases by 50% each claim-free year up to 100%, and claims do not reduce this bonus, helping your coverage grow over time.

great.name: Modern Treatments
great.quote: The Company will indemnify... for expenses incurred... for treatment taken through following advance technology methods: ... Robotic surgeries ... Stereotactic radio surgeries ... Immunotherapy- Monoclonal Antibody ... Stem cell therapy: Hematopoietic stem cells for bone marrow transplant...
great.explanation: Advanced medical procedures like robotic surgeries and immunotherapy are covered under hospitalization, ensuring access to modern treatments.

great.name: Domiciliary Hospitalization
great.quote: The Company will indemnify the Insured Person, only through Reimbursement Facility... towards Domiciliary Hospitalization
great.explanation: Treatment at home is covered when medically necessary and meeting policy conditions, providing flexibility beyond hospital stays.

good.name: PED Waiting Period
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of a pre-existing Disease (PED)... shall be excluded until the expiry of 36 months of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the first policy with insurer.
good.explanation: Pre-existing diseases are covered after 36 months of continuous coverage, which is within the normal industry range.

good.name: Specific Illness Waiting
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of the listed conditions, surgeries/treatments shall be excluded until the expiry of 24 months of continuous coverage...
good.explanation: Named ailments are covered after 24 months of continuous coverage, which is standard in the market.

good.name: Initial Waiting Period
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of any illness within 30 days from the first policy commencement date shall be excluded except claims arising due to an accident
good.explanation: There is a 30-day waiting period for illnesses from policy start, but accidents are covered immediately.

good.name: Pre-hospitalization Cover
good.quote: For a period of 60 days immediately prior to the Insured Person's date of admission to the Hospital
good.explanation: Medical expenses related to the same condition are covered up to 60 days before hospital admission.

good.name: Post-hospitalization Cover
good.quote: For a period of 180 days immediately after the Insured Person's date of discharge from the hospital
good.explanation: Medical expenses related to the same condition are covered up to 180 days after hospital discharge.

bad.name: Consumables
bad.quote: Any item or condition or treatment specified in List of Non-Medical Items (Annexure – I to Policy Terms & Conditions).
bad.explanation: Common consumables like gloves and masks are excluded by default, so you may have to pay for these unless you buy an optional cover.

bad.name: Co-pay
bad.quote: If this Optional Benefit is opted... reduction in the total premium... If the Insured Person takes Medical Treatment in hospitals other than those listed in Annexure – III... shall bear a Co-Payment of 20% on each and every Claim... However, no such additional co-payment shall be applicable if treatment is availed in the hospitals listed in Annexure III
bad.explanation: If you choose the optional benefit, you pay 20% co-pay for treatment in non-network hospitals, otherwise no extra co-pay applies.

bad.name: Co-pay
bad.quote: The Co-payment proportion ( If opted ) shall be borne by the Insured Person on each Claim
bad.reference: General Conditions Applicable To All The Benefits, point 4 and Clause 3.2.7
bad.explanation: The policy mentions co-pay applies if opted but does not clarify the default co-pay percentage, so check your policy schedule for details.

unclear.name: Cashless Network
unclear.quote: Network Provider ... means the Hospitals enlisted by an Insurer, TPA or jointly by an Insurer and TPA to provide medical services to an Insured by a Cashless Facility.
unclear.explanation: The document defines network hospitals but does not specify how many are included; verify the current network size with the insurer.
